blocking.why: key-matched rows where both sides hold a value and the values disagree, or the candidate holds a value where the oracle holds NULL; the row exists on both sides, so this is not a coverage gap

declared_unrepresentable.anchor_age: No FHIR element. Patient.birthDate stores only (anchor_year - anchor_age); no anchor_age extension exists, so anchor_age is not recoverable exactly and is emitted as typed NULL.
declared_unrepresentable.anchor_year: No FHIR element. Patient.birthDate stores only (anchor_year - anchor_age); min(year(Encounter.period.start)) is approximately 99% recoverable but not exact, so anchor_year is emitted as typed NULL.

divergence.policy: Row count is not a hard gate. `mismatch` means a divergence class that a MIMIC-on-FHIR coverage gap cannot produce; the judge cannot override it. `review` means only gap-shaped divergence remains and the judge decides, citing the specific FHIR element or path.

declared_unrepresentable.anchor_year: No FHIR element. Patient.birthDate stores only (anchor_year - anchor_age); min(year(Encounter.period.start)) is approximately 99% recoverable but not exact, so anchor_year is emitted as typed NULL.

reviewable.why: key-matched rows where the candidate is NULL and the oracle holds a value; consistent with the FHIR element for that column not existing
